preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= len(S) <= 5000 for S in S_list)
preconditions.description: Each string S has a length between 2 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in {'A', 'B'} for c in S) for S in S_list)
preconditions.description: Each character in each string S is either 'A' or 'B'.

postconditions.description: The number of lines in the output matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] in {'-1', 'AA', 'AB', 'BA', 'BB'} for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each line in the output is either '-1' or a valid subsequence of length 2 ('AA', 'AB', 'BA', 'BB').

postconditions.expression: all(count_subsequences(S_list[i], output[i]) == 2 if output[i] != '-1' else count_subsequences(S_list[i], output[i]) == 0 for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output string appears exactly twice as a subsequence in S if it is not '-1'; otherwise, it does not appear as a subsequence.
